blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings was little changed, 92 in June and 93 in September (+1.1%), and it took 8.3% of the city’s 351 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 147 in June to 128 in September (−12.9%), and it took 14.2% of the city’s 591 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Sullivan Station for detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August (a sellers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sullivan Station than in June?
faq.a: In Sullivan Station, listings of houses was little changed, 92 in June and 93 in September (+1.1%); condos and townhomes fell from 147 in June to 128 in September (−12.9%).

faq.q: How big is Sullivan Station compared with the rest of Surrey?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sullivan Station held 8.3% of the 1,120 houses listed in Surrey and 8.4% of the 1,523 condos and townhomes listed in Surrey.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sullivan Station from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 29 houses and 84 condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Station over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
